evidence.description: The source compares PM, BM, TFPM and TFBM in LiFSI electrolytes and proposes a molecular solvation rationale. The task selects their local molecular interactions, not full electrolyte transport, interphase formation or battery performance. Source facts/author interpretation are distinguished in the source_scope_audit.
group_6 冻结的LiFSI参考及部分PM/TFPM结果保留；BM/TFBM及配对方法/构象不确定性不足。 Historical validation is not V2 acceptance or mandatory route.

How do the molecular identities of PM, BM, TFPM and TFBM affect local lithium solvation in the presence of FSI, and what account of their differences is supported by a defensible molecular investigation? Determine the extent to which the evidence supports a common explanation across these four solvents. Define the observable, molecular composition and reference of every comparison. Show adequate validity for any claimed structure or relative interaction, and justify transfer from selected models to the stated local question. If electrostatic or charge descriptors are used, distinguish potential units/locations from fitted atomic charges and document the calculation; an ESP extremum is not automatically a RESP charge.
